src/index.ts.name: Public entry
src/index.ts.description: Offers the action caps and the cap object; importing it switches nothing on.

src/rate-limit.ts.name: Budget check
src/rate-limit.ts.description: Takes one action from a napplet's per-minute budget and startup allowance, tighter when out of focus, and says allow, flag or block.

src/limiter.ts.name: Cap object
src/limiter.ts.description: Holds a host's chosen settings and the running counts, allows settings changes without resetting counts, and can soften blocks to flags for watching only.
